# Synthetic Tooling Notes

## Music tagger commands

To tag music files, run `music-tagger --rename` with the normalized album name.

## Path configuration

Set the content root with `KB_CONTENT_DIR` before running a command.

## Named hosts

The synthetic named host is `Aurora`.
